subject: Adjusting Size of Symbols in Legend

messages.author: e7a71d967e60bb41
messages.subject: Adjusting Size of Symbols in Legend
parts:
Dear All,
Please have a look at the snippet at the end of the email.
I really have only a few questions
(1) What if I want to remove the legend title without leaving its
corresponding space white within the legend rectangle? I have tried
using "" as legend title and shrinking the legend title text size to 0,
but I am sure there must be a better way of doing this.
(2) I would like to increase the size of the dots in the legend only,
without changing the point size in the main figure. I toyed with
scale_size, but unsuccessfully. Any suggestion is appreciated.

Many thanks.

Lorenzo

time_bit <- seq(0,8,length=100)
inf_num <- 1-exp(-time_bit)

time_unique_long_2 <- c()
cumulative_number_infected_long <- c()

label_infection <- c()


for (i in seq(8)){
time_unique_long_2 <- c(time_unique_long_2,time_bit)
cumulative_number_infected_long <- c(cumulative_number_infected_long,
(i+inf_num))
label_infection <- c(label_infection,rep(i, length(inf_num)))

}

my_dframe <- cbind(as.data.frame(time_unique_long_2),

as.data.frame(cumulative_number_infected_long),as.data.frame(label_infection))

names(my_dframe) <- c("time","infected","time_inf")

my_dframe$time_inf <- factor(my_dframe$time_inf)

lbls <- c("12:00 to 13:00","13:00 to 14:00","14:00 to 15:00","15:00 to
16:00","16:00 to 17:00","17:00 to 18:00","18:00 to 19:00",
"19:00 to 20:00")

clock_time <- c("12:00","14:00","16:00","18:00","20:00")
x_mid <- seq(0,8,by=2)
gpl <- ggplot(my_dframe,aes(x=time,y=infected))+
geom_point(alpha=1,size=0.7, aes( color=time_inf))+
scale_colour_hue("Infection \n start time",labels=lbls,
breaks=seq(length(lbls))) +
xlab("Time")+
ylab("Number of infected Individuals")+
scale_x_continuous(labels=clock_time, breaks=x_mid)+
opts(legend.text = theme_text(size = 10, vjust=0.8))+
opts(legend.title = theme_text(size = 15,hjust=0))+
opts( legend.background=theme_rect(fill='white'))+
opts(title = expression(paste("Dublin: July, ",14^th)))+
opts(plot.title = theme_text(size = 20))+
opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size = 20))+
opts(axis.title.y = theme_text(size = 20, angle=90))+
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size=15, colour="gray",vjust=1))+
opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size=15, colour="gray", hjust=1))


CairoPDF(file="legend-test.pdf")

print(gpl)
dev.off()
